user_sees: 'No workouts in the last 4 weeks'
'Log a workout, then come back here to ask an AI about it.'

user_sees: 'Couldn't read your workouts'
'Please go back and open this page again.'
must_not: An endless empty page with no words

user_sees: 'Couldn’t open sharing'
'Please try again.'

start: Ask an AI page shown, then a workout is deleted in History

must_not: The deleted workout still in the text

steps.action: Log a workout with only warm-up sets, come back
user_sees: The count unchanged
must_not: A workout with only warm-ups counted

start: Ask an AI page, member signed in and linked to a gym

steps.action: Read the text on the page before sharing
user_sees: Only dates, exercise names, sets and the muscles with few sets
must_not: Name, phone number, gym name or body weight

steps.action: Share it to an app
user_sees: The text goes only to the app the member picked
must_not: A copy sent to MettleUp or to the gym
